item.title: Black coffee may improve brain power, offer other health benefits, says nutritionist
item.description: Black coffee sits on the stronger end of caffeinated beverages.A study published in The Journal of Nutrition in July 2025 found that black coffee consumption is linked to a lower mortality rate. In other words, drinking coffee without added sugar/cream was associated with a 14 per cent lower risk of all-cause mortality. item.title: Man accused in robbery, arms cases beaten to death in Noakhali
item.description: A young man, accused in six cases, was beaten to death in a mob attack Noakhali's Kabirhat upazila on Saturday night.Deceased Mizanur Rahman Rony, 35, was son of Md Shahid.The attack took place in front of Kazi Bari near Kalirhat bazar of the upazila.A group of youths later distributed sweets in the local market after branding the victim a robber.According to local residence, Mizanur Rahman was accused in six cases related to robbery, arms and attack on government officials.
